description: This file defines an Android activity named PlayerActivity, which manages media playback of workout videos, displays an overlay with workout details such as title, elapsed time, and estimated calories, and handles the lifecycle of the ExoPlayer instance.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An activity that plays a workout video and displays overlay information with controls tied to the activity's lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves workout data, and binds UI elements.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Creates and configures the ExoPlayer instance, and starts the periodic overlay update.

methods.name: updateOverlay
methods.description: Updates the overlay displaying elapsed time and estimated calories based on the current playback position.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the media player.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method that releases the media player resources.
